sequence of patches and process it by a standard Transformer encoder as used in NLP. This simple,
yet scalable, strategy works surprisingly well when coupled with pre-training on large datasets.

datasets, whilst being relatively cheap to pre-train.

content.text:
### 结论对比
ViT 以**图像分类的有监督标签**作为主要监督信号，训练目标是在大规模图像数据集上学到图像类别映射；CLIP 以**网页上的自然语言-图像配对**作为监督信号，训练目标是通过对比学习对齐图像与文本的多模态嵌入空间。

| 维度 | ViT | CLIP |
|---|---|---|
| 监督信号 | 图像级类别标签（如 ImageNet-21k / JFT-300M 的分类标注） | 大规模网页采集的（图像，自然语言文本）配对 |
| 训练目标 | 图像识别任务的分类映射，标准监督预训练 | 对比式跨模态对齐：最大化正配对余弦相似度、最小化负配对相似度，优化对称交叉熵损失 |

---

### 原文证据
1. **ViT**
   - 论文明确说明其核心范式是在大规模图像数据集上进行**监督预训练**，之后迁移到各类图像识别基准上：“Our Vision Transformer (ViT) attains excellent results when pre-trained at sufficient scale and transferred to tasks with fewer datapoints. When pre-trained on the public ImageNet-21k dataset or the in-house JFT-300M dataset, ViT approaches or beats state of the art on multiple image recognition benchmarks.” [vit:p2:c1]
   - 文中也提到自监督预训练（如 masked patch prediction）只是初步探索，其性能仍显著落后于大规模监督预训练：“our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet... but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.” [vit:p9:c2]

2. **CLIP**
   - 其核心是**Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training**，使用自然语言作为监督：“an efficient method of learning from natural language supervision.” [clip:p2:c5]
   - 训练目标为对比损失：给定一个包含 N 对（图像，文本）的批次，CLIP 优化对称交叉熵损失，最大化 N 个真实配对的余弦相似度，同时最小化其余 N²−N 个错误配对的相似度：“maximize the cosine similarity of the image and text embeddings of the N real pairs in the batch while minimizing the cosine similarity of the embeddings of the N²−N incorrect pairings. We optimize a symmetric cross entropy loss over these similarity scores.” [clip:p4:c4]

---

下一步建议：如果需要更细粒度的损失函数实现细节，可以进一步读取两篇论文的算法伪代码章节做逐行对比。

| 训练目标 | 图像识别任务的分类映射，标准监督预训练 | 对比式跨模态对齐：最大化正配对余弦相似度、最小化负配对相似度，优化对称交叉熵损失 |

1. **ViT**

2. **CLIP**
   - 其核心是**Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training**，使用自然语言作为监督：“an efficient method of learning from natural language supervision.” [clip:p2:c5]
   - 训练目标为对比损失：给定一个包含 N 对（图像，文本）的批次，CLIP 优化对称交叉熵损失，最大化 N 个真实配对的余弦相似度，同时最小化其余 N²−N 个错误配对的相似度：“maximize the cosine similarity of the image and text embeddings of the N real pairs in the batch while minimizing the cosine similarity of the embeddings of the N²−N incorrect pairings. We optimize a symmetric cross entropy loss over these similarity scores.” [clip:p4:c4]

We have explored the direct application of Transformers to image recognition. Unlike prior works
using self-attention in computer vision, we do not introduce image-speciﬁc inductive biases into

Thus, Vision Transformer matches or exceeds the state of the art on many image classiﬁcation
